visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a black sports bra and high-waisted shorts, stands on a light-colored wooden floor in a dance studio. She initiates her routine by gripping a vertical metal pole with both hands, extending her right leg outward while leaning her upper body back with controlled grace. The studio walls are a neutral beige, and the lighting is bright and uniform across the scene. (2) As the routine progresses, she lifts her body off the ground, spinning fluidly around the pole. Her legs move in synchronized, geometric patterns, alternating between extension and tucking. The camera captures her full body as she rotates, showcasing her physical strength and the smooth texture of the metallic pole against the studio's minimalist background. (3) She transitions to a higher position on the pole, using her core and limbs to maintain a secure grip. She performs an inverted split and several elegant poses, her hair flowing behind her as she spins. The scene is characterized by continuous, flowing movement with no distractions in the background except for the studio logo 'PV STUDIO' visible on the far wall. (4) The routine concludes as she slowly descends the pole, maintaining a final low spin near the floor. She gracefully stands back up, adjusting her posture and looking towards the camera. The video maintains a consistent full-shot perspective, focusing entirely on the physical performance and the spatial relationship between the dancer and the apparatus.
